## Summary

1. **Diagnosis**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Reviewing the deploy history confirmed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rollback**: Rolled back to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed due to an orchestrator error (only us-east completed), but a retry completed the rollback across all regions.

3. **Verification**: All three regions are now running v2.3.0. Health checks pass and the error rate is back to 0.2%.

4. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** documenting the failure, rollback action (including the partial-failure/retry), and a follow-up to investigate v2.3.1's failure before any re-attempted rollout. The on-call engineer has been paged.
